stories.headline: Google's Gemini can now browse Chrome for you while logged in
stories.blurb: Gemini Spark can open Chrome, navigate sites using your saved passwords and logged-in accounts, and handle repetitive web tasks on your behalf. Google's AI assistant essentially acts as a browser automation tool that can complete errands across multiple sites without you clicking through each step.
stories.why_it_matters: AI agents are moving from chat windows into actually doing things in your real browser.
stories.original_headline: Gemini Spark now has Chrome web-browsing capabilities

stories.headline: Anthropic just signed a $10 billion cloud deal with a startup that's months old
stories.blurb: Anthropic locked in $10 billion of computing capacity from a brand-new infrastructure startup to handle surging demand for Claude. The deal shows how fast AI companies are burning through compute—and how willing they are to bet on unproven providers to get it.
stories.why_it_matters: Even top AI labs can't get enough chips from the usual suspects anymore.
stories.original_headline: Anthropic Inks $10 Billion Computing Deal With New Cloud Startup

stories.headline: Alibaba releases its biggest AI model yet, claims it rivals GPT-4 and Claude
stories.blurb: Chinese tech giant Alibaba released Qwen3.8-Max, which it calls its most capable AI model to date. The company claims performance comparable to frontier systems from OpenAI and Anthropic, as well as domestic competitors like Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.
stories.why_it_matters: China's largest AI labs are now claiming parity with US frontier models.
stories.original_headline: China’s Alibaba takes another swipe at America’s AI supremacy

stories.headline: Cursor can now edit your Google Docs and Sheets directly
stories.blurb: The AI code editor just added plugins that let it read and write across Google Workspace — Docs, Sheets, Drive, Gmail. You can now ask Cursor to draft a doc, update a spreadsheet, or pull info from your files without leaving the editor.
stories.why_it_matters: AI coding tools are now desktop agents that control your actual work apps.
